name: Corn noodle with tuna offal
nameVi: Bún bắp lòng cá ngừ đại dương
summary: Corn noodle in a light, sweet broth of tuna stomach and roe with tomato and pineapple, finished with a hot kick. The stomach is crisp, and the roe crackles and is rich.
origin: Phu Yen. The noodle is the An Dân corn noodle from Tuy An.
culture: Hiệp hội Văn hóa Ẩm thực Việt Nam certified this bowl among 121 dishes in phase I-2022, the only Phú Yên dish on that list.
texture: The yellow strands are chewier than rice noodle, with a smell of their own. The tuna stomach is crisp, and the roe crackles and is fatty.
taste: The broth is light and sweet, free of fishy smell, and finishes hot. Tomato and pineapple go into the ladle with scallion, rau răm, and pepper.
howToEat: Ladle the broth over the noodle, add scallion, rau răm, and pepper, and eat it with herbs, bean sprouts, and salty fish sauce.
seoTitle: Bun bap with tuna offal — the certified Phu Yen bowl
seoDescription: Corn noodle with tuna stomach, roe, tomato, and pineapple, the certified Phu Yen bowl.
